_comment: Title and short description of each PDF/image in the Master set. Describes what kind of information a document holds, never its content. Keyed by path relative to the Master set root.

Printed Case/Printed case_Hardware requi.title: Printed Case – Hardware requirements
Printed Case/Printed case_Hardware requi.description: A one-image table of the metric bolts and nylock nuts needed to assemble the 3D-printed case. It also notes that wider cases need extra hinge hardware. Check it before ordering fasteners.

tower (for v1)/ModuBOX - Tower.PDF.title: ModuBOX Tower (for v1 cases)
tower (for v1)/ModuBOX - Tower.PDF.description: One A3 sheet with an overview drawing of a tall tower that holds v1 cases. It includes a panel list with part counts and material thicknesses, in mm.

work table/Modubox Work table.PDF.title: ModuBOX Work table
work table/Modubox Work table.PDF.description: Seven A3 sheets for a large work table built over two drawer cabinets on casters. They cover an overview, drawers in three heights, cabinet frames, doors/shelves and a gridded top, with part tables in mm.

Case cart (for v1)/ModuBOX case cart.pdf.title: Case cart – step-by-step assembly guide
Case cart (for v1)/ModuBOX case cart.pdf.description: An illustrated guide for a rolling cart that holds six v1 cases on drawer runners. It has a combined cut and hardware list, drilling layouts and exploded assembly steps, in mm. It uses 'drawer Case holder.STL'.

Case v1/ModuBOX Case.PDF.title: ModuBOX Case v1 – frame & drill guide
Case v1/ModuBOX Case.PDF.description: Sheet 1 has the panel list, views and a fastener table for the original wooden case in 9 mm stock. Sheet 2 is a drill-guide template: print it at 1:1 scale.

Case v1/ModuBOX double case frame.PDF.title: Double case frame (v1)
Case v1/ModuBOX double case frame.PDF.description: One A3 sheet for a small open frame with a shelf that stacks two v1 cases. It gives the panel list for 12 mm stock plus views with mm dimensions.

Wood Case_v2/cut list and HW/wood case (.title: Wood Case v2 – cut list & hardware (6 mm / 1/4")
Wood Case_v2/cut list and HW/wood case (.description: Cut list and hardware for the v2 wood case in 6 mm sheet, with size lookup tables per panel by case width and height (2H–6H). Use it with the 6 mm printed parts and templates.

Wood Case_v2/cut list and HW/wood case (.title: Wood Case v2 – cut list & hardware (7 mm / 9/32")
Wood Case_v2/cut list and HW/wood case (.description: The same five-sheet document, sized for 7 mm sheet. Use it with the 7 mm printed parts and templates.

Wood Case_v2/cut list and HW/wood case (.description: The same five-sheet document, sized for 8 mm sheet. Use it with the 8 mm printed parts and templates.

Wood Case_v2/cut list and HW/wood case (.description: The same five-sheet document, sized for 9 mm sheet. Use it with the 9 mm printed parts and templates.

Wood Case_v2/cut list and HW/wood case (.description: The same five-sheet document, sized for 10 mm sheet. Use it with the 10 mm printed parts and templates.

Wood Case_v2/cut list and HW/wood case (.description: The same five-sheet document, sized for 12 mm sheet. Use it with the 12 mm printed parts and templates.

assortment cart/Plans/ModuBOX 6 Unit car.title: 6-unit assortment cart – drawings
assortment cart/Plans/ModuBOX 6 Unit car.description: A full plan set for a rolling drawer cart: overall size, drawer layouts, material table, frame and drawer drawings, handle cutouts, sheet cut layouts and slide-hole layouts, in mm and inch.

assortment cart/Plans/ModuBOX 9 Unit car.title: 9-unit assortment cart – drawings
assortment cart/Plans/ModuBOX 9 Unit car.description: The taller 9-unit version of the cart plans, with four drawer layout options, a material table, sheet cut layouts and slide-hole layouts. In mm and inch.

assortment cart/Plans/ModuBOX 12 Unit ca.title: 12-unit assortment cart – drawings
assortment cart/Plans/ModuBOX 12 Unit ca.description: The tallest, 12-unit version of the cart plans, with five drawer layout options, a material table, sheet cut layouts and slide-hole layouts. In mm and inch.
